name: Villa de Otura (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of blue, white, green, white and blue in the proportions 1:1:4:1:1, the green charged with a white six-petalled flower.
history: Villa de Otura adopted its arms and flag officially on 4 July 2005; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, of five horizontal stripes in the proportions 1/8, 1/8, 1/2, 1/8 and 1/8, blue, white, green, white and blue, the green charged with a white six-petalled flower.
